notes: Rolling a ball to the exit is a maze whose solvable topology is the game, so Puzzle on puzzle-maze with the Maze / Labyrinth preset, and the P6 stays because an image cannot guarantee the ball has a route to the exit. Nobody walks in this build: the player tilts the tray from outside it, which is the SET case, so the tray, walls and ball are all built while traversal segmentation and jump-gap checks are skipped. The answers settle the two open decisions, a classic wooden puzzle tray at single handheld scale with one compact maze, so I dropped the preset's collectible-nodes since there is nothing to gather and kept path-loop for the branch-and-rejoin corridors, with gate-solve placing the goal the ball has to reach. Not P5, since the tray is real physical geometry rather than a flat screen.
